after2_start.name: {name}
after2_start.text: *After school. Two notifications on my phone.*

after2_msg_dain.name: Dain
after2_msg_dain.text: Get to the gym!! Today's the real deal!!

after2_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
after2_msg_seo.text: Can you swing by the council room? I'm short-handed.

after2_msg_yuna.name: {name}
after2_msg_yuna.text: *Nothing from Yuna. — That's Yuna. But while packing my bag, the morning note falls out of my pocket. The words 'library annex' catch my eye.*

after2_nurse_transition.name: {name}
after2_nurse_transition.text: *My elbow stings. I should stop by the nurse's office.*

after2_dain_1.name: {name}
after2_dain_1.text: *The gym. Dain is doing warm-ups in front of the volleyball net.*

after2_dain_4.name: Dain
after2_dain_4.text: I got here ten minutes early!!

after2_dain_5.name: {name}
after2_dain_5.text: *That means you were early. Not that I was late.*

after2_dain_6.name: Dain
after2_dain_6.text: Okay, deal! Five serves — clear the net at least three times and you win! Lose, and you're buying tteokbokki!

after2_dain_9.name: {name}
after2_dain_9.text: *I serve. — Surprisingly, the second serve goes cleanly over the net.*

after2_dain_11b.name: {name}
after2_dain_11b.text: *We left the gym and walked down the street.*

after2_dain_12.name: Dain
after2_dain_12.text: AGHHH I lost!! — Wait, you're actually good?! Didn't you say you don't do sports?!

after2_dain_14.name: Dain
after2_dain_14.text: *Jaw drops* WHAT?! Did you just hustle me?!

after2_dain_15.name: {name}
after2_dain_15.text: Didn't hustle you. You just never asked.

after2_dain_16.name: Dain
after2_dain_16.text: *Punches my shoulder* You sneak!! HAHA — okay that was actually fun!

after2_dain_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_skinship_3.text: *She pulls her hand back. Doesn't look sorry at all. — My palm is still warm.*

after2_dain_end.name: {name}
after2_dain_end.text: *Her eyes curve into half-moons. The same eyes I saw yesterday.*

after2_dain_end_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2.text: Hey — you actually know your sports, don't you?

after2_dain_end_2c.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2c.text: 'A little' doesn't move like that! — Just own it, you're good.

after2_dain_end_2d.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_2d.text: You were way better than me.

after2_dain_end_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3.text: *Dain pauses her chopsticks. Just for a moment.*

after2_dain_end_3b.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3b.text: ...Obviously! I was on an athletic scholarship, you know!

after2_dain_end_3c.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3c.text: *'Used to be.' Past tense. — Something tells me not to push it.*

after2_dain_end_3e.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3e.text: *She changed the subject. — Dain's way of caring is clumsy, but it's warm.*

after2_dain_return.name: {name}
after2_dain_return.text: *On the way back to school. Reached the school gate.*

after2_seo_1.name: {name}
after2_seo_1.text: *The student council room. Seoyeon sits behind a pile of documents. Alone.*

after2_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_2.text: You actually came. — Honestly, I figured you wouldn't.

after2_seo_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_3.text: I show up when someone calls.

after2_seo_5.name: {name}
after2_seo_5.text: You're the one who asked for help.

after2_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_6.text: I didn't ask. I offered you a chance.

after2_seo_7.name: {name}
after2_seo_7.text: *Commanding tone, but somehow it's starting to feel familiar. — Is this her version of asking nicely?*

after2_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8.text: These go by date, those by club. — Are you any good at organizing?

after2_seo_8a2.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a2.text: Not great, but not bad either.

after2_seo_8a4.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a4.text: Kind of like the way you compliment people. Vague.

after2_seo_8b4.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4.text: It's a compliment. Take the win.

after2_seo_choice1.name: {name}
after2_seo_choice1.text: *The sunset streams in through the window. An orange glow washes over Seoyeon's profile. — I felt like saying something.*
choices: The sunset's nice. — I mean the view, of course.
Does your neck hurt? Take a break.

after2_seo_sunset_joke.name: {name}
after2_seo_sunset_joke.text: *Seoyeon pauses for a moment. And then — she laughs. Not just her lips, but her eyes. A smile I've never seen before.*

after2_seo_sunset_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_react.text: ...You're the first person to just toss out a line like that.

after2_seo_neck_react.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_react.text: *Seoyeon rolls her shoulders. I hear them crack.*

after2_seo_neck_high.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high.text: *I close my eyes and lean into it.*

after2_seo_9.name: {name}
after2_seo_9.text: *The sunset washes over the student council room. The paperwork is almost done.*

after2_seo_choice2.name: {name}
choices: Should I stay a bit longer? Seems like there's still some left
If we're done, I'll head out

after2_seo_stay.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay.text: *Seoyeon sets the documents down and gazes out the window. The sunset light touches her face.*

after2_seo_stay_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_2.text: ...I like this hour. Alone in the council room, I don't have to play any role.

after2_seo_stay_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3.text: Even the council president gets time off?

after2_seo_stay_3c.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3c.text: *'Except here.' — The roof or the council room — Seoyeon needs places where she can take the mask off.*

after2_seo_end.name: {name}
after2_seo_end.text: *I step out of the student council room. The sunset paints the hallway.*

after2_seo_skinship_1.name: {name}
after2_seo_skinship_1.text: *Seoyeon reaches out. Picks off a speck of dust from my collar. Her hand grazes my neck.*

after2_seo_skinship_2.name: {name}
after2_seo_skinship_2.text: *Seoyeon's fingers stop. She turns her head without a word. — I hold my breath for a second.*

after2_seo_return.name: {name}
after2_seo_return.text: *Left the student council room. Walking toward the school gate.*

after2_yuna_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1.text: *There was no message from Yuna. But my feet are heading toward the library. Why? — I'm not sure. Maybe because of the morning note.*

after2_yuna_2.name: {name}
after2_yuna_2.text: *I slip in quietly. Yuna is on the sofa, reading. The sunset is streaming through the window.*

after2_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_5.text: Do I have to call for you to show up?

after2_yuna_6.name: {name}
after2_yuna_6.text: *She was waiting. — The thought quietly makes me happy.*

after2_yuna_8b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8b.text: *A door left open by coincidence. — Yuna's 'coincidence' usually means 'on purpose.' I sit down next to her. Yuna holds out one earbud.*

after2_yuna_8d.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8d.text: *A quiet piano piece begins to play. The sunset is painting the room. Yuna reads, I listen to music. Not a word. — It's not uncomfortable.*

after2_yuna_choice_pre1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre1.text: *After a long pause* ...People who come here after school.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3.text: There hasn't been one since that senior.

after2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
after2_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna said two sentences in a row. — For someone who normally speaks one line at a time.*

after2_yuna_everyday_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_react.text: ...Every day's a bit much, though. Sometimes... is okay.

after2_yuna_quiet_react.name: {name}
after2_yuna_quiet_react.text: *Yuna smiles ever so slightly. — This one smile makes the whole day feel okay.*

after2_yuna_end.name: {name}
after2_yuna_end.text: *Late notifications on my phone — Dain's 'I was waiting, you know?' and Seoyeon's 'Tell me if your schedule changes.' Sitting next to Yuna listening to music, the sunset already faded. — When I'm next to this person, I keep wanting to come back.*

after2_yuna_skinship_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_1.text: *We reached for the same book — our hands overlap.*

after2_yuna_skinship_2.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_2.text: *Yuna doesn't pull away first. Three seconds. She lowers her gaze.*

after2_yuna_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_3.text: *Hands separate. Yuna picks up the book and hands it over. Without a word.*

after2_yuna_return.name: {name}
after2_yuna_return.text: *Left the library annex. The sun is setting.*

minsu_warn_1.name: {name}
minsu_warn_1.text: *Walking home. Just past the school gate when — Minsu falls in step behind me.*

minsu_warn_6.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_6.text: Seoyeon, Dain, Yuna — all three of them smile at you. ...Just sayin'. *He shrugs and walks ahead.*

after2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after2_dain_freetalk.text: *We stepped into the tteokbokki shop near school.* *Eating tteokbokki with Dain and chatting.*
after2_dain_freetalk.context: Day 2 afterschool, came to tteokbokki shop after a volleyball bet at the gym. Getting closer. Tone: Feeling closer than yesterday. Banter feels natural and comfortable. Push-pull flirting. No heavy topics yet.
after2_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Competitive and straightforward, but exclamation marks disappear when she's being genuine.

hidden_nurse_d2_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_1.text: *When I roll up my sleeve, there's a small scrape on my elbow. It's nothing serious, but it's bleeding a little.*

hidden_nurse_d2_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_2.text: Two days in a row — should I start issuing you a nurse's office membership?

hidden_nurse_d2_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_5.text: Here... like this. There, done. This angle holds the longest.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.text: *Her hands are close, applying the bandage.*
choices: All that care for one little bandage

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.text: ...My hands are usually cold. I guess they're warm today.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.text: *smiles* It's called being thorough. If you put it on carelessly, it falls off.

hidden_nurse_d2_6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_6.text: *Checking the bandage — I notice a notebook poking out of her desk drawer. Pale green cover. The open page has something written in letter form. 'Yujin, today—' That's as far as I read before the nurse closes the drawer.*

hidden_nurse_d2_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_7.text: *Closing the drawer* You didn't see that, okay? ...Teachers are allowed their secrets too.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.text: *She says it's a secret, laughing — but her eyes aren't laughing.*
choices: You sure have a lot of secrets. Can't you tell me just one?

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.text: *narrows eyes* Just one? ...Fine then. I like cocoa more than coffee. That's the secret.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.text: *Laughs softly* Secret. Teachers get to have secrets too.

hidden_nurse_d2_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_8.text: All done, get back to class. — Next time, come without an injury.

hidden_nurse_d2_9.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_9.text: You can come by even without a reason. Just not during class. After school. *I left the nurse's office.*

after2_dain_9_b.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_b.text: *Eyes widening* Huh? I was gonna go easy, but never mind.

after2_dain_9_c.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_c.text: *Dain lowers her stance. Her eyes change.*

after2_dain_9_e.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_e.text: *The rally goes back and forth. Dain's movements are — clearly not ordinary. Fast, precise, her body remembering every move. This girl is really good. But — every time she lands, she puts more weight on her left foot. Like she's avoiding the right.*

after2_dain_9_f.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_f.text: *Final score: 3-2. Won by a hair. Dain stands up — and rubs her right knee a little. I think she did the same thing in the gym yesterday. An unconscious gesture.*

after2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_b.text: *The tteokbokki place near school. Dain blows on her tteokbokki and talks.*

after2_seo_4_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_4_b.text: *The word 'please' doesn't seem to exist in her vocabulary.*

after2_seo_6_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_6_b.text: *She has a gift for making requests sound like orders. We start sorting documents. Event budgets, club applications. Quite the pile.*

after2_seo_8b4_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_8b4_b.text: *She actually said 'compliment' out loud. — That seems rare for her.*

after2_seo_sunset_joke_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_joke_b.text: *Even hiding the corner of her mouth behind the papers, I can tell she's smiling.*

after2_seo_sunset_react_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_sunset_react_b.text: *Even after saying that, the corners of Seoyeon's lips stay lifted for a while.*

after2_seo_neck_react_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_react_c.text: *Seoyeon stands and moves behind me. Her hand rests on my shoulder.*

after2_seo_neck_high_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_c.text: *Whose hand is that? — It's Seoyeon's hand on my shoulder. My thoughts are scrambled. That's how tense I am.*

after2_seo_neck_low_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low_b.text: What was that all of a sudden?

after2_seo_neck_low_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low_c.text: *Seoyeon's hand pauses in the air for a moment.*

after2_yuna_1_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1_b.text: *The annex hallway. Not a soul around. — The door to the secret reading room is slightly ajar.*

after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.text: *Yuna doesn't look away. That one sentence stays with me longer than it should.*

after2_yuna_everyday_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_b.text: ...Come if you want. I won't stop you.

minsu_warn_4_b.name: {name}
minsu_warn_4_b.text: *Sounds like a joke, but Minsu's eyes aren't in on it.*

minsu_warn_1_b.name: {name}
minsu_warn_1_b.text: *Minsu strides up and falls into step beside me.*

minsu_warn_15_b.name: Dain
minsu_warn_15_b.text: Let's have another bet tomorrow!! Different game!!

minsu_warn_15_c.name: Seoyeon
minsu_warn_15_c.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow. Come.

after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.text: *Her fingertips press lightly at the back of my neck, then slowly let go. For a moment, neither of us says anything.*

after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.text: *It doesn't even sound like permission, but somehow it stays with me.*
